# mtncloud_ssl_certificate (Data Source)

Looks up one SSL certificate by ID or by name, including one made in the console. Certificates are used by load balancers and apps. The certificate and key themselves are never read. A name must match exactly one SSL certificate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By name (matched exactly); `id = 123` works too.
data "mtncloud_ssl_certificate" "example" {
  name = "www-example"
}

output "ssl_certificate_domain_name" {
  value = data.mtncloud_ssl_certificate.example.domain_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the SSL certificate. Give this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the SSL certificate, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `cert_type` (String) Certificate type.
- `common_name` (String) Common name (CN) of the certificate.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `domain_name` (String) Domain name the certificate is for.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the certificate is enabled.
- `generated` (Boolean) Whether MTN Cloud generated it.
- `self_signed` (Boolean) Whether it is self-signed.
- `type` (String) Code of the certificate's source type.
- `wildcard` (Boolean) Whether it is a wildcard certificate.
